description: Theme tokens, utilities, icons and the ThemeProvider. Install this first.
docs: Next: add `@import "./styles/expressive.css";` (path relative to your CSS file) right after `@import "tailwindcss";`, wrap your app in <ThemeProvider>, and load Roboto Flex + Material Symbols Rounded from Google Fonts. See the README.
